parameters.name: AgentVersion
parameters.description: Set this parameter to V2 to route requests to the ROS Agent V2 backend.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of sessions to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Filters sessions by mode. Valid values: IaCCodeNormal and IaCCodePipeline.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token returned in the previous response. Do not pass this parameter for the first page. Do not reuse an old token after switching Mode.
